title: Brenner Base Tunnel
description: [AI generated] The Brenner Base Tunnel (Brennerbasistunnel, BBT) is a major railway infrastructure project, not a company in the traditional sense, though it is managed by Brenner Base Tunnel BBT SE, a joint venture between Austria and Italy.
